user_title: Dual-process theory: System 1 and System 2, carefully stated

preview.title: What Kahneman actually claimed about two systems
preview.description: Careful walkthrough of dual-process accounts of thinking and their criticisms.

content: Dual-process theory distinguishes fast automatic Type 1 processes from slow deliberate Type 2 processes. The two systems are labels for families of processes, not literal brain modules. Type 1 handles language, face recognition and intuitive physics in parallel without effort. Type 2 depends on working memory and is serial, which makes it slow and capacity limited. Cognitive reflection test items measure the willingness to override an intuitive wrong answer. Critics argue the dichotomy hides heterogeneity within each family of processes. Default-interventionist models specify when Type 2 checks and corrects Type 1 outputs.
rationale: Teoria estabelecida de cognição e decisão, diretamente no includes de cognitive_psychology.

preview.title: Cognitive load theory: a primer for teachers
preview.description: Primer on cognitive load theory and its instructional effects.

content: Cognitive load theory models learning as the management of limited working memory resources. Intrinsic load reflects element interactivity inherent to the material being learned. Extraneous load is imposed by poor instructional design and can be reduced without loss. The worked example effect shows novices learn more from studying solutions than solving problems. The expertise reversal effect warns that scaffolds which help novices hinder experts. Goal-free problems and split-source effects are two of the dozens of replicated findings. Reviews connect the theory to evolutionary estimates of long-term memory capacity. The ending suggests a twenty-minute exercise that consolidates the main content without any tool beyond the basics.

preview.title: Send, Sync and the anatomy of safe threads
preview.description: Explanation of Rust concurrency guarantees via Send, Sync and ownership.

content: Rust moves the whole class of data races to compile time with two marker traits. Send marks types safe to transfer across threads; Sync marks types safe to share by reference.
